thread:
Rae (Partnerships): Quick sync: NovaSys routed two marketplace leads (Borealis Labs, Meridian Health). Need to finalize ROE + SFDC tagging. Suggested default: marketplace leads -> partner-touch unless customer asks for vendor-contracting. Thoughts?

Liam (SalesOps): I like defaulting to partner-touch. Can we add a binary field `Marketplace_Origin__c` so we can run queries? Also add `CoSell_Status__c` with values [AE, Partner, Joint].

Priya (AE): Borealis asked Redwood to handle billing and contract. I'd mark Borealis AE-owned. Meridian wants NovaSys to deliver integration + support, so that looks partner-led.

Kenji (SI Partner - NovaSys): Meridian will lead the infra work and expects to manage SOW. We need a clear SOW handoff + approval chain so later disputes don't happen. Also please include a reseller discount flow for co-sell deals.

Tasha (Solutions): For the handoff checklist include: discovery notes, infra footprint, required redwood features (VPC/private deploy?), expected seq length & QPS, and a short rollout plan.

Rae (Partnerships): Draft ROE proposal: 1) If customer explicitly requests Redwood contract -> AE-owned. 2) If partner implements >30% of project or owns SOW -> Partner-led. 3) If revenue split >20/80 or deep product changes -> Joint. Add a mandatory intro call within 3 business days.

Liam (SalesOps): SFDC snippet to standardize (for ops team):
```
opportunity:
  recordType = "Opportunity - PartnerMarket"
  fields:
    Marketplace_Origin__c = "NovaSys"
    CoSell_Status__c = "Partner"
    Partner_Owner__c = "NovaSys"
    Partner_Contribution__c = "45"
    Handoff_Requested_TS__c = "1765809999"
```
Make `Partner_Contribution__c` a number percentage field.

Priya (AE): Confirming I'll own Borealis. Please add Borealis to the public-announce pipeline? They want a joint announcement but prefer Redwood-led PR.

Rae (Partnerships): We'll coordinate comms. Action items: (1) Liam to create SFDC fields & update validation rules, (2) Rae to publish 1-pager SOP + handoff checklist, (3) Kenji to provide SOW template, (4) Priya to confirm Borealis PR cadence.

workflow-bot: task created: Partnerships SOP draft due in 5 days (1766245599) :spiral_calendar:

Kenji (SI Partner - NovaSys): I'll drop our SOW template in the shared drive and ping once up. Thanks all.

Rae (Partnerships): Great — I'll post the SOP link in #partnerships once live and tag the three account threads. Closing this sync thread. :lock_with_ink_pen:
